scope: Repair offline-reproduced normal SMC connection failures: refused HCI command submission, automatic Create/Cancel ownership, and independent peer ATT requests/indications during discovery. Bound missing Create status without losing late results or sending Cancel before acknowledgement. Export retained first/latest failures and critical events through ED_DIAG, guard uninitialized host state, and automatically produce a truthful USB diagnostic report with a pinned device port. Build the exact Elite development application and unchanged selected controller with existing code, static RAM and pool budgets. The hardware test has not occurred; these simulated failures do not prove the historical physical cause. Existing integrated mappings, project/drum features, storage layout, sample quality and controller are unchanged.

checks.reason: The central command, discovery, retry, stop and failure-report paths changed. Run their public-HCI/ACL fault injections under ASan/UBSan, the existing recorded SMC payload replay and actual application input consumer, and the DIAG buffer/decoder/watcher checks. The watcher fixture covers historical failures, blocked boot, selected USB port disappearance and automatic saved reports. Only leak detection is disabled for the sandbox's unavailable process introspection; address and undefined-behavior checks remain enabled.
